title: Baked at home, in Pacific Beach
lede: I'm Chana Oiknine. I bake from my kitchen in Pacific Beach, San Diego — small batches, from scratch, for celebrations and ordinary days.
paragraphs: This is a home bakery, not a shop with a case. You tell me what you need, and I confirm what I can bake and when.
The kitchen is fully kosher. Everything I make is pareve, which means non-dairy. I use kosher ingredients and I keep the work personal: I mix it, shape it, and bake it myself.

If you want a cake, a flavor, or a size that is not on the menu, send a custom request. I will answer with a price and a plain yes or no. Please give me a week. There is no minimum — one loaf is a complete order.
